tei:div.tei:p: 1$0000250gter gsar rdo rje phur pa lha nag gri gug 'bar ba'i rgya can gyi rgyun khyer nyams len bzhugs so// 1$0000300na mo gu ru shrī badzra ku mā ra ya/

'dir gter gsar rdo rje phur pa lha nag gri gug 'bar ba'i rgya can gyi rgyun gyi nyams len snying po tsam zhig dgod par/ skyabs sems bdun dag sogs gter kha gsar rnying ci rigs kyi phur pa sogs yi dam gyi las gzhung spyi 'gro bzhin du byas nas/ dngos gzhi ni/

chos dbyings skye ba med pa'i ngang nyid las// ma rtogs 'gro la byams dang snying rjer shar// stong dang snying rje zung 'jug rig pa'i rtsal// rgyu yi snying po hūm̐ chen sngon po las// 'byung ba rim brtsegs ri rab chen po'i dbus// srid bcud rdo rje phur pa'i dkyil 'khor gzugs// snang ba'i rgya mdud gong mar gzhal yas khang*/ khrag 'thung 'bar ba'i bkod pa gsal rdzogs kyi// zla gam ye shes 'char sgo'i klong gi dbus// pad nyi ru tra bsnol ba'i gdan steng du// bskyed pa rgyu

nyid yongs su gyur pa las// dpal chen khro rgyal rdo rje gzhon nu ni// mig sman ltar gnag zhal gsum phyag drug pa'i// g.yas dkar g.yon dmar dgod gshe gtum rngam tshul// g.yas gnyis rdo rje rtse dgu rtse lnga dang*// g.yon gnyis me dpung kha ṭwāṃ rtsa phyag gnyis// thugs kar seng ldeng phur pa sgril ba'i tshul// sku smad gnam lcags phur zhabs 'bar ba ni// ru tra bar gcod bdud kyi snying la gzir// rdo rje rin chen 'bar ba'i khyung gshog gdengs// sku la dur khrod 'bar ba'i chas kyis brgyan// gsang ba'i yum mchog 'khor lo rgyas 'debs ma// mthing ljang rdo rje dung dmar 'dzin pas 'khyud// zhabs gnyis yab 'khril dur khrod rgyan chas rdzogs// yab yum gnyis med bskal pa'i me dpung klong*// bzhugs pa'i sku dbus rtsa gsum 'khor lo lnga// tshigs kyi 'khor lo bzhi dang bcas pa rnams// dwangs gsal sgrib med gsal ba'i 'khor lo'i dbus// rim bzhin
thams cad sku mdog nag po phur zhabs/
rang rang khra thabs rgyan dang cha lugs rdzogs// phyi 'khor

bdud rtsi'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' ni// rdor sems mthing dmar khro chags sgeg pa'i sku /rdo rje dril bsnams yum bcas thugs ka ru// rin chen zur brgyad sbubs su zla nyi'i steng*// shin tu phra ba'i ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐// de mthar

rtsa ba'i sngags kyis bskor bar gyur// ye nas rang rdzogs khrag 'thung khro bo'i lha// ma lus 'dir gshegs gnyis med brtan par bzhugs// phyi nang sbyor sgrol de bzhin nyid mchod bzhes// sku gsung thugs yon phrin las gus pas bstod// nyams chag 'gal bshags mchog thun dngos grub stsol// sngags kyi phreng bas mgal me ltar 'khor bas// yab kyi zhal nas yum gyi zhal du zhugs// 'khor 'das snod bcud kun bsdus yum mkhar bskyil// dhū ti'i lam nas thugs srog hūm̐ la bstim/
'di yan bde chen gyi bzlas pa/
ma rungs sde brgyad bdud dang dam sri'i rigs// sngags phreng las 'phros 'od zer me dpung gis// gzhob tu bsregs sbyangs dwangs ma sbyor mtshams nas// thugs srog hūm̐ gi zhabs su thim pa yis/
dbang sdud tshar gcod phrin las kun 'grub gyur// oṃ badzra kī li kī la sarba bighnān baṃ hūm̐: āḥdzaḥphaṭaḥ
sham bur dngos grub bsdus ste sbyor ba/ yang na/
dgra bgegs sgrol ba/ ci nus bzlas mthar/

srid bcud rdo rje phur bu'i dkyil 'khor kun// ye shes sems dpa' he ru ka la thim// de nyid ting 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ sngon la// hūm̐ yang blo 'das rdzogs pa chen po'i klong*// rig pa'i ngo bo dpal chen he ru ka /stong pa'i rang bzhin shes rab yum gyi dbyings// rtsal snang 'gag med khro bcu sras dang 'khor// kun kyang rig stong zung 'jug ka dag las// sgyu ma tsam du thun mtshams lha skur ldang*//

gter gsar rdo rje phur pa lha nag gri gug 'bar ba'i rgya can rgyun gyi nyams len snying por dril ba 'di/ zab chos 'di nyid kyi bdag po rgyal ba 'bri gung pa chos kyi grags pa'i mchog gi sprul sku'i bka' bzhin/ dharma swā mīs bka' rgya bkrol te phul ba bar chad bdud sde'i dpung las rnam par rgyal ba'i rgyur gyur cig// /
